meta.stage_protocol: Stages run C1 -> C3+C4 -> C2, each from its own manifest. A stage's chosen K values are frozen into the top-level 'params' of the LATER stage manifests and of this one (for the control-tables run), each a revision with a new manifest_hash recorded in its 'journal'; a stage manifest sweeps only its own keys, so no frozen key is ever both a parameter and a sweep axis. Phase B of C3+C4: EXP-0002-c3c4.json meta.phase_B. Per point: 'matrix --manifest M --point P --out DIR' (the point's 100 seeds), then 'exp0002.py --calib DIR --point P'.
